$comment: Poses, faces and people without the mac helper (FRM1-SUB, vision's src/subjects): hosted at components.taalcut.app since 2026-11-11, included in the production manifest and verified by a complete public SHA-256 download. One archive, made by tools/components/pack-subjects-onnx.sh, two ONNX files at its root. rtmo_s_coco.onnx: RTMO-s (Lu et al. 2024) from MMPose's COCO checkpoint rtmo-s_8xb32-600e_coco-640x640-8db55a59_20231211.pth (download.openmmlab.com, sha256 8db55a5974d4d31164cc327805c57932cc7b4f79874b5e5bfbbfa32a7d4e5b05), MMPose Apache-2.0; exported with mmdeploy 1.3.1 (commit bc75c9d6c8940aa03d0e1e5b5962bd930478ba77, Apache-2.0) to 39667335 bytes, sha256 4b5d3e663769effa29df3538f29f66584135f662031109ddd6794b738ebf11c7, then its six grouped convolutions rewritten as the same dense ones (onnxruntime's WebGPU provider computes them wrongly): 43586517 bytes, sha256 191f8f2c87dddbb875102b61cf788ec3810a570efc40595f743220aae72adc83. Trained on COCO train2017 keypoints only; its backbone was initialised from mmdetection's yolox_s_8x8_300e_coco, trained from scratch on COCO 2017. yolox_nano.onnx: YOLOX-Nano by Megvii, github.com/Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX release 0.1.1rc0 (tag commit e1052df71842031413f6030723c3607b839c80ce), Apache-2.0; 3659407 bytes, sha256 c789161ed43c8269fcd4e67c67eeeb4e80c622da2eb296a20bc6007bd18a0b7d, unchanged; trained on COCO 2017. COCO's annotations are CC BY 4.0, its images under their Flickr licences. Eval: tools/evals/src/subjects/onnx.ts.

licence.attribution: RTMO-s pose estimator from MMPose (open-mmlab/mmpose), Apache-2.0, exported to ONNX by Taalcut with mmdeploy (Apache-2.0). YOLOX-Nano object detector by Megvii (Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX), Apache-2.0, hosted unchanged.
